identitySignals: Name matches a registered nonprofit: 'Oakland Youth Chorus' in Oakland, CA (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer, EIN 94-2535518), matching the agenda location Oakland, CA
Organization runs in-school choral music classes, including middle school classes, matching OUSD's 'Classroom & academic programs' contracts for Claremont, Edna Brewer and Bret Harte Middle Schools
California Arts Council grantee page describes in-school and after-school choral programs with Title I school partners in Oakland, at 685 14th Street, Oakland
research.notes: Organization's own website has a broken TLS certificate and could not be fetched; website listed on the California Arts Council page is www.oaklandyouthchorus.org but omitted because it could not be verified. The only email found was a named staff address, so email is null. Chamber page lists the website field oddly (admin@oigc.org), suggesting a shared office with Oakland Interfaith Gospel Choir; not used.

profile.summary: Oakland Youth Chorus is a nonprofit youth choral music education organization in Oakland, California. It offers in-school choral classes, after-school choruses and advanced ensembles for children and youth, with a focus on students at Title I schools in Oakland and nearby cities.

Legal name, EIN, org type, address, phone and the neutral summary are all supported; website and email are correctly null.
